results.title: Albuquerque crews on standby in final stretch of monsoon season
results.description: The City of Albuquerque’s Department of Municipal Development is keeping crews on high alert for the final two months of monsoon season, deploying street sweepers and flood-response teams to keep roads safe.

results.title: Donald Trump posts bizarre AI photo of himself as Elvis in social media meltdown
results.description: Donald Trump posted a wild AI-generated photo of himself as Elvis Presley on Saturday, offering no explanation for the image as the Iran war continues to intensify

results.title: Britney Spears goes TOPLESS in wild clip before twerking on the floor in front of housekeeper
results.description: The Oops!...I Did It Again singer, 44, was seen twirling and waving her arms while clad in various states of near-nakedness before letting go of her top entirely.
